label: Fixed demonstration inputs — scenario only, no live equipment control

demand.source: Building Data Genome Project 2 v1.0, bundled public benchmark history
demand.note: Replay of pinned historical whole-building readings, never current Sime Darby measurements. The existing seasonal model is fitted locally to the available history.

weather.source: Authored fixed demo weather assumptions; no external weather request
weather.note: A fictional daylight profile and demo timezone, independent of the BDG2 site's timezone and historical forecast dates. Not an actual location forecast.

inputs.location_name: Fictional video-demo site (not the BDG2 building)

assumptions: PV size, performance and temperature coefficient are demonstration assumptions, not equipment measurements or vendor guarantees.
Battery starts at its 20% reserve. Charging is disabled in this walkthrough, so its reserve remains protected and Solar/Grid changes are easy to inspect.
MYR 0.50/kWh is an arbitrary flat demo tariff, not an applicable Malaysian tariff. Cost excludes CAPEX, battery charging, degradation and tariff schedules.
All weather values and the demonstration coordinates are fictional inputs. No relationship to the BDG2 asset location is asserted.
Changing these defaults requires a new version of this centrally maintained profile.
